webhooks.detail: Scraper API async jobs POST results to a webhook endpoint URL on completion; Web Unlocker and SERP async also support webhook_url notifications.

evidence.quote: Bright Data sends a `POST` request to that URL with the scraped data once the job completes.

sandbox.detail: Every new account gets 5,000 free credits per month (shared across Web Unlocker, SERP, Web Scraper API, Scraper Studio), usable for testing.

evidence.quote: Every new Bright Data account gets 5,000 free credits per month

rate_limits.summary: Unfunded accounts: 1,000 req/min (SERP, Web Unlocker, Proxy); Scraper API: 25 HTTP 429s per IP in 5 min triggers 1-hour IP block

evidence.quote: restricted to a default rate limit of 1,000 requests per minute across the SERP API, Web Unlocker API and Proxy products
REST endpoints for every product live under `/api-reference` on this docs site.
